title: Strata engine validation from native builds to request lifecycle
summary: Keep source/CPU checks separate from required accelerator parity, model output, cancellation and matched performance evidence.

zh-CN.title: Strata 原生构建与请求生命周期验证
zh-CN.summary: 区分源码及 CPU 检查、必需的加速器一致性、模型输出、取消清理和配对性能证据。

conditions: Record executable/build hashes, model bytes, backend, tokenizer, resolved config and workload.
Use the matching source checkout for native tests and the supplied model for runtime gates.

recommendations: Treat setup.py as an application installer/launcher rather than setuptools packaging or a smoke test.
Freeze correctness and quality gates before comparisons; preserve source/CPU/device/model/service evidence as separate layers.
validation_plan: Run applicable no-download CPU checks, build the changed native backend and execute its actual parity targets.
Test cache restoration, long prompts, concurrent slots, cancellation and the next request, then compare repeated same-day baseline/candidate runs.
limitations: A configure/import check or absent fixture cannot certify the engine; unavailable required hardware leaves the campaign INCONCLUSIVE.
Batch versus solo text differences require the applicable CPU/GPU rounding contract before attributing them to scheduling.
This indexed abstract links to the complete bilingual skill and source evidence; it is imported guidance, not a benchmark result.
Accelerator execution, real-model quality and service performance remain unverified for this import. Qualify each target revision, model, backend and workload separately.
